claim.claim-text: 1. A strobel (10) for an article of footwear comprising:
2. The strobel (10) of claim 1, wherein the upper layer (14) has a bottom surface.
3. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 2, wherein the base layer (12) is in the form of a ring having the central aperture extending therethrough.
4. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the base layer (12) is formed of a non-woven material comprising polymer.
5. The strobel (10) of claim 4, wherein the polymer is polyester, nylon, thermoplastic polyurethane, or cotton.
6. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 4 to 5, wherein the polymer is polyurethane, silicone, foamed rubber, or blown rubber.
7. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein upper outer edges of the upper layer (14) are curved and lack a sharp corner.
8. The strobel (10) of claim 7, wherein a radius of the upper outer edges of the upper layer (14) is between 3.5 mm and 3.8 mm.
9. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the base layer (12) is a single piece.

10. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the base layer (12) comprises a first piece (12A) forming a medial side of the base layer (12) and a second piece (12B) forming a lateral side of the base layer (12).

11. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein a thickness T of the base layer (12) is between 0.8 mm and 1.0 mm, and wherein a thickness H of the upper layer (14) is between 3.5 mm and 3.8 mm.

12. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein width of the first portion (15A) of the base layer (12) is between 5 mm and 9 mm, and wherein width of the second portion (15B) of the base layer (12) is between 4 mm and 6 mm.

13. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the second portion (15B) extends about an entire outer perimeter of base layer (12) and defines a peripheral flange to secure the strobel (10) to an upper of the article of footwear.
14. The strobel (10) of any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the first piece (12A) and second piece (12B) are positioned together in abutting relationship to form the ring-shaped base layer (12).
15. An article of footwear comprising the strobel (10) according to any one of claims 1 to 14.
